For My Sis,,

Not my sister by blood, but my sister by heart

We do not share the same blood, yet somehow you are my family. Some bonds are never written in names, they are chosen, quietly, by the heart.   You were not born my sister, Apu, but you became one the day you cared. Every prayer you whispered for me, every smile you gave, was proof.   So on your special day, dear Apu, may life return all you give away: the love that asks no reason, the warmth that asks for nothing.
